findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink

Untrusted content: agoda_com__search, airbnb_com__search, amazon_com__products, angi_com__search, apartments_com__search, apps_apple_com__search, apps_apple_com__apps, axs_com__search, bayt_com__companies, booking_com__search, dhgate_com__search, etsy_com__search, etsy_com__shops, europages_com__companies, fiverr_com__search, funda_nl__search, github_com__search, glassdoor_com__search, google_maps_scraper__search, hackernews_com__search, hackernews_com__items, homestars_com__search, idealista_com__search, instacart_com__products, jiffyondemand_com__search, lazada_com__search, play_google_com__search, propertyguru_com__search, reddit_com__search, rightmove_com__search, seatgeek_com__events, seek_com__search, seek_com__employers, shopee_com__search, stubhub_com__search, telegram_com__search, ticketmaster_com__search, ubereats_com__stores, upwork_com__freelancers, walmart_com__search, watsons_com__search, yelp_com__search, zillow_com__search, zoopla_co_uk__search · Private data: alibaba_1688_com__products, faire_com__brands, faire_com__products, huggingface_co__search, mercadolibre_com__catalog, yelp_com__search · Public sink: reddit_com__search, telegram_com__search.
